dialogue.speaker: Brother Tallow
dialogue.text: [He does not reach for the slate this time. He simply stares at you.]

dialogue.speaker: Brother Tallow
dialogue.text: They called my case. Forty years I kept silent, and you are the only person who ever made me wish I hadn't.

dialogue.speaker: Brother Tallow
dialogue.text: [He leaves. The silence he takes with him feels heavier than before.]
